what_happened: Direct verification confirmed git-commit-scoped.sh's existing V9 gate already classifies an out-of-repository pathspec distinctly (its own ledger, exit code, and WARN text), but git-commit-phase.sh's upstream Containment Self-Check drops the same path earlier with the generic undeclared-scope message before V9 ever sees it -- a reusable precedent for the fix rather than new logic.

Confirmed cause 1 (external source store) is deployment-relative: in this repository, .claude-extensions.json's core.source_dir resolves inside this repo's own git root (not external), so this repository's own agent-system/** containment drops (tasks 444, 450) are caused by cause 2 and the addendum's regenerated-surface gap, not by a genuinely external repository. The externality was reproduced instead against BimodalLogic's own .claude-extensions.json, which points the identical absolute path outside its own repo root.
